> Hey team, I'm a bit confused on this PR cause I thought the risk of double events was more on clicks 🤔

I made this PR based on the issue described where if you have multiple hits widgets/connectors, you get multiple insights view events, which seems wrong / not needed?
This solution is too hardcoded on view, and there's another approach with waiting a tick before triggering sendEvent, which would be useful for default sendEvent too. I'll close this for now.

title: fix(events): prevent sending duplicate view events
